text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Nakayama Festa is challenging
herself
by building a giant tower of
cards.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh heh. Almost at the top. Here we...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Nope. I'm too nervous. Look at how my
hands are
shaking. I'll just take a quick
breather over here.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ack! No way! You're not telling me that blew it over?! Damn it, I was so close!
